title: CyberMedica Global Catalog Content Integrity + Product Detail UX Master Corrective
launchGoal: Максимально быстро довести Stage до состояния, пригодного для Production и запуска рекламы.

productDetailHero.ctaWhitespaceTarget: 24–40 px visual bottom spacing, no large blank right panel

description.goal: 1–3 readable paragraphs about purpose and use

features.heading: Ключевые особенности
features.purpose: short scan-friendly facts, derived only from source
features.targetLength: preferably <= 90 characters per card; normally <= 2 desktop lines
forbid: show compatibility alone as the only feature when product-specific facts exist
features.visibilityRule: if source contains meaningful product capabilities/features, section must be visible

specifications.rule: show all authoritative technical characteristics on Product Detail
specifications.catalogCards: do not show technical specification rows

legacyCatalogAudit.scope: all existing published products, not only EndoMarket imports
legacyCatalogAudit.rule: detect root cause and audit all legacy descriptions for placeholders/tokens/missing content before Stage acceptance

observedIssues: feature cards reproduce long source sentences and are visually heavy
hero uses thumbnail strip
large empty hero space
content must remain source-complete while presentation is shortened
businessDecision: description stays source-accurate
features become concise UI summaries
specifications stay complete
gallery becomes carousel without thumbnails
featureSummaryExamples: Изображение высокого разрешения с естественной цветопередачей

observedIssues: feature completeness inconsistent between adjacent models
some models have no visible features/specs despite source-rich descriptions
some descriptions are long and machine-like
EB-500 was previously incomplete
businessDecision: semantic source audit for each model
extract concise product-specific differentiators
do not infer missing source facts

observedIssues: near-identical long generic descriptions
single key feature HV-3101 TM Medinova is not an adequate product feature
model differentiation is hidden
businessDecision: description must be model-specific or shared family text plus explicit model distinction
key features must surface the actual differences between models
requiredFeatureTypes: совместимость с HV-3101 as secondary feature

observedIssues: very long mixed description
single compatibility feature instead of model differentiators
businessDecision: split purpose into description
put numerical model differences into key features/specifications
compatibility is secondary, not the only feature

observedIssues: AF feature cards are present but should be concise and model-specific
HV-3101 features are useful but too verbose
productGroups.businessDecision: retain source facts, shorten presentation cards

observedIssues: descriptions and features are templated and too similar across screen sizes
model differentiation is not immediately visible
businessDecision: highlight diagonal, resolution, brightness, color depth, interfaces and model-specific capabilities
do not reuse identical generic feature set when source values differ

observedIssues: source-rich features exist
feature section becomes a wall of cards
businessDecision: keep all unique source facts
compress wording and group closely related process facts where no unique claim is lost
do not remove meaningful cycle/compatibility/water-treatment facts

observedIssues: rich descriptions/specifications
feature section missing despite many source capabilities
businessDecision: create concise source-derived features from storage capacity, HEPA/air, UV, purge, temperature/display/printer where supported

observedIssues: technical specification tables are strong
feature sections often missing or inconsistent
some descriptions sound machine-translated/marketing-heavy
businessDecision: keep full technical tables
derive concise key features only from source capabilities
remove unsupported superlatives and translation noise

observedIssues: source contains 4 feature groups but Stage hides feature section
approvedFeatureSummaries: Для пациентов разного возраста и комплекции

observedIssues: HD-350 content incomplete/empty on Stage
HD-500 missing/not discoverable in Stage catalog
HD-550 missing/not discoverable in Stage catalog
businessDecision: HD-350 source: EndoMarket exact product page
HD-500 source: exact HD-500 page, never substitute HD-550
HD-550 source: exact HD-550 page
resolve existing identity/projection before creating any new product to avoid duplicates

requirements: all visible catalog products pass content integrity audit
missing authoritative descriptions = 0 where source exists
feature section hidden while meaningful source capabilities exist = 0
